title: Disable Insecure Protocols (Telnet)
remediation: Disable the Telnet server service. Use SSH instead.

title: Enforce Strong SSH Version
remediation: Configure the device to exclusively accept SSH Protocol Version 2 connections.

title: Admin Access Logging (Syslog)
remediation: Enable logging for administrative access and forward logs to a centralized Syslog server.

title: Encrypt Plaintext Passwords
remediation: Ensure all plaintext passwords stored in the configuration file are encrypted using a strong hashing algorithm.
